about:
RMC Plastics operates in north Houston, Texas, where it was founded in 1966 by three friends — B.L. Jacquet, L.L. 'Mack' McKay Jr., and J.F. Cox — who started the business as JMC Plastics and Manufacturing in McKay’s home garage. The company moved to its current north Houston site as it grew, and after McKay bought out his partners, the business remained family-run until the McKay family sold it to the Robertson family of Houston in 2013, at which point it was renamed RMC Plastics, Inc.

The company runs 12 injection molding machines of varying sizes, producing precision plastic and rubber molded parts. Its services span mold design and fabrication, product design, material selection consulting, production molding, assembly, and warehousing of customer-owned inventory for quick turnaround. RMC also offers prototyping with low-production molds, single- or multi-cavity tooling, and two- or three-plate mold configurations.

RMC serves customers in consumer products, oil and gas, electric, gas, and water utilities, construction, plumbing, and medical industries. The company maintains deep stock of proprietary parts in its Houston warehouse to support rapid fulfillment for these sectors.

The Robertson family emphasizes direct owner involvement, quick decision-making, and flexibility as key differentiators, positioning the firm as a responsive, family-owned partner that invests time in each project to deliver quality and value.
